```{r}
# Install required packages if not already installed
#install.packages("quanteda")
#install.packages("quanteda.textstats")
```

```{r}
# Load the necessary libraries
library(quanteda)
library(quanteda.textstats)
```

```{r}
# Define a sentence
sentenceA <- "The brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog barks."
```

```{r}
# Convert to corpus
corp <- corpus(sentenceA)
```

```{r}
# Tokenize into words
toks <- tokens(
  sentenceA,
  remove_punct = TRUE,
  remove_symbols = TRUE,
  remove_numbers = TRUE
) |>
  tokens_tolower()
```

```{r}
# Create a document-feature matrix (DFM)
dfm_mat <- dfm(toks)
```

```{r}
# Calculate entropy
entropy <- textstat_entropy(dfm_mat)
```

```{r}
# K = number of distinct terms actually present in each document
K <- Matrix::rowSums(dfm_mat > 0)
```

```{r}
# Print all distinct terms
print(featnames(dfm_mat))
```

```{r}
# Maximum possible entropy for each document
Hmax <- log(K, base = 2)
```

```{r}
entropy <- textstat_entropy(dfm_mat, margin = "documents", base = 2)
```

```{r}
print(entropy)
```

```{r}
entropy$normalized_entropy <- ifelse(K > 1, entropy$entropy / Hmax, 0)
```

```{r}
print(entropy$normalized_entropy)
```

```{r}
?textstat_entropy
```
